name: claude_p12_native_harvest_restart (B14 crash/restart conservation; NOT RUN; two-run protocol)

steps._note: TWO-RUN PROTOCOL (the step runner cannot restart the game inside one scenario). RUN A = steps up to the 'KILL POINT' marker, then the operator/agent runs `gamebridge.ps1 restart` (kill + relaunch of the SAME disposable save; do not use launch -Reset). RUN B = the steps after the marker, executed via the second scenario invocation (re-run this file with env P12_PHASE=B or split at the marker). Fixture as claude_p12_native_harvest.json. NativeHarvestQualified must be true for the run.

KILL POINT (REQUEST R6): run once per phase P in {Armed, Damaged, Witnessed, Credited} and once per credit sub-state (bag-prepared, bag-bound): `rbnpcb14 halt ${NPC}

` (fixture-only, CodexTest save) makes the executor stop right AFTER saving that phase and print `[RBNPC] b14 halted phase=

`. Then restart.
KILL POINT: <<< run `restart` here (Stop-Game; Start-Game) and resume the scenario with the post-restart section >>>
RUN B (after restart): same save reloaded, NPC loaded, owner online.

RECOVERY EXPECTATIONS by halted phase (REAL via R1/R3/R4 and escrow list):  Armed -> block undamaged => re-armed under a NEW operation, no wear, no award lost; Damaged with receipt (HasPostImage) -> Witnessed with the SAVED deliverable (same witness list as before the kill); Damaged without receipt and destroying hit -> Escrowed (escrow list count=1, nothing credited, bag unchanged) until `rbnpcescrow award|abort`; Witnessed/bag-prepared -> the credit completes into the SAME reserved cell, exactly one stack; Witnessed/bag-bound -> verified or Ambiguous (hold), never a second placement; Credited -> outcome recorded once with the SAME CompletedUtcTicks, row acknowledged.
For halted=Damaged-without-receipt the list shows count=1; resolve with `rbnpcescrow award <npc> confirm=CodexTest` and re-assert; every other variant must show count=0.

CONSERVATION (REAL): witness list sum (R1, taken BEFORE the kill and again after) == NPC bag delta + source-settled items + escrow; NO duplicate stack (one binding id per witness index; compare npcgear before/after); tool UseTimes increased EXACTLY once across the restart (U_after - U_before == one wear; the toolwear row is `applied` once, never re-applied: R4); award moved once (skill.management).
